description:
Get the transcript of a YouTube video.

        Args:
            video_id: YouTube video ID (11 characters, e.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ')
            lang: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'it'). Auto-detected if omitted.
            format: Output format — 'text' (default), 'json' (segments with timestamps),
                'srt', 'vtt' (WebVTT subtitles) or 'chunks' (segments merged into
                timestamped chunks of about chunk_size characters, for embeddings).
            chunk_size: format 'chunks' only: target characters per chunk (200-4000,
                default 1000); segments are never split.
            chunk_overlap: format 'chunks' only: characters of whole segments repeated
                from the previous chunk (0-1000, default 0).
name: get_transcript
title: Get transcript
